text:
Alice R: Quick heads-up — launching feature/edge-routing tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Want to lock change window from 08:30–10:00 UTC. Please confirm pins and rollback owners. TL;DR: canary -> 25% -> 100% over 20m slices. Release notes: https://redwood/release/PR-4321 :rocket:

Ben I: On it. Pinning v2.4.3 to prod canary groups now. @deploy-bot do the pin.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pin request received for model v2.4.3 -> applying to canary-slice-1... success (pin id: pin-20260401-1) :white_check_mark:

Caroline M: Test matrix ran green on staging. Smoke steps below. Also added rollback playbook in the release doc.

Caroline M: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -d '{"input":"smoke"}'
# expect 200, perf < 150ms for 16-token warmup
```

Dave P: Rollback owners: Dave P (primary), Ben I (secondary). My rollback command will be:

Dave P: ```
deploy-bot rollback --pin pin-20260401-1 --target all
```

ops-oncall: Ops oncall acked. Observability hooks set (trace, latency alert @ 300ms, error rate alert 1%).

Alice R: Thanks. Two asks: 1) Quiet-window starts 08:30 UTC — no merges or infra changes. 2) If canary error >1% in first 10m -> immediate rollback to v2.4.2.

Ben I: Noted. I'll hold merges. Anyone need an exemption?

Caroline M: Small docs fix inbound, won't touch code. No exemption.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout at 09:00 UTC — slices: canary-1(25%) @09:00, canary-2(50%) @09:20, prod(100%) @09:40. Webhook -> #release-war-room. Notifications will be posted.

Alice R: Perfect. I'll run final preflight at 08:45 UTC. Closing out now :lock:

Ben I: :thumbsup: Good luck.
